start: Finish screen of a 'Push Day' workout: 1h 04m, bench and dumbbells, one new record, heavier than last time

user_sees: Picture: MettleUp name (or the gym) top left, 'Tue, 6 Oct 2026' top right, 'Push Day', 'Workout complete · +45 kg more than previous'
TIME '1h 04m', KG LIFTED, SETS, RECORDS boxes
Front and back body drawing with worked muscles lit
'NEW RECORD' with the exercise and e.g. 'Heaviest weight 85 kg'
Up to 4 rows like '3 × Bench Press' with the best set '85 kg × 8', then '+ 2 more exercises'
must_not: The member's name or body weight
Warm-up sets counted in SETS or the best set
A number cut in a box (numbers shrink, never cut)

user_sees: The phone share sheet with one PNG 'mettleup-workout-<day>'
must_not: A PNG with the body drawing or logo missing

start: Another way in: a saved workout's page or the History list menu

steps.action: Open a workout from History, open its menu, tap 'Share as a picture'
user_sees: The same picture for that workout, with its own day
must_not: Today's date on an older workout
The '+ kg more than previous' line from another workout

start: Another kind: a body-weight or cardio workout

steps.action: Share a workout of only pull-ups and dips
user_sees: 'REPS' in the second box, best sets like '10 reps' or '+10 kg × 6'
must_not: A 'Best workout' kilo record that has body weight in it

steps.action: Share a workout of only runs or planks
user_sees: 'DISTANCE' or 'TIME' in the second box; 'MUSCLES WORKED' only when there are muscles
must_not: An empty heading with nothing under it

start: An empty workout, a workout with no length, or a drawing that fails

steps.action: Share a workout whose length is unknown (logged by chat)
Tap 'Share picture' when the drawing fails
user_sees: 'Could not make the picture' with 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'

start: Many records, some printed and some not, and a workout beaten then not beaten

steps.action: Share a workout with 7 records over 4 exercises
user_sees: 'NEW RECORDS', as many blocks as fit, then 'and 3 more'
must_not: RECORDS box and the printed list disagreeing with no 'and N more'

steps.action: Share the next workout that is lighter than the previous
must_not: 'Lighter than previous' or a minus on the picture

start: What the workout picture can give away

steps.action: Share a workout where today has 2 more pull-ups than last time and the rest is the same
user_sees: Only workout facts; 'It never shows your name or body weight.'
must_not: '+155 kg more than previous' that is two pull-ups times the member's body weight, beside 'KG LIFTED' that leaves body weight out
Any number that divides back to body weight
